title: Houston spells out a text message he never saw

tellings.quote: text she texted it to me he never saw the text and he spelled out what was on the text

plain: A mother in Atlanta, Georgia, named Katie says that someone sent her a text message that her son Houston never saw, and that he then spelled out what the text said. She told it in connection with a documentary called the Telepathy Tapes, about children said to read minds, as a sign that he can know things he was never shown.
